name: ontario-s-housing-supply-progress
notes:
This data shows how many new homes have been started towards municipal housing targets. 

2023 and 2024 data were reviewed in 2024 and 2025. Data published here reflect post-review adjustments and may not align with Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation data as published in its 2023 and 2024 surveys [(Starts and Completions Survey)](https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en#TableMapChart/35/2/Ontario). However, over a two-year period, statistics across both organizations will align. 

Learn more about [Ontario’s progress to build more homes faster.](https://www.ontario.ca/page/building-more-homes)

notes_translated.fr:
Ces données montrent combien de mises en chantier de logements neufs ont débuté pour atteindre les cibles municipales en matière de logements. 

Les données de 2023 et 2024 ont été examinées en 2024 et en 2025. Les données publiées ici reflètent les rajustements postérieurs à l’examen et elles pourraient ne pas correspondre aux données de la Société canadienne d’hypothèques et de logement publiées dans ses enquêtes de 2023 et 2024 [(enquête sur les mises en chantier et les achèvements)](https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/fr#Profile/1/1/Canada). Toutefois, sur une période de deux ans, les statistiques des deux organisations seront harmonisées. 

Apprenez-en davantage sur les [progrès réalisés par l’Ontario pour construire plus de maisons, plus rapidement.](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/page/construction-de-plus-de-logements)

title: Ontario’s housing supply progress

title_translated.fr: Progrès réalisés par l’Ontario pour l’offre de logements

resources.description:
This data shows how many new homes have been started towards municipal housing targets. 

Included:

* municipality
* 10-year housing targets (2022-2031)
* total housing progress since 2022
* target for 2024
* total 2024 housing progress, comprised of:
housing starts 
    * additional residential units
    * long-term care beds
    * postsecondary student beds (new as of 2024) 
    * licensed congregate retirement home suites (new as of 2024)
* housing progress expressed as a percentage of the annual target
* housing target status

Examples of housing that is not included:

* group homes
* transitional/supportive housing 

2023 and 2024 data were reviewed in 2024 and 2025. Data published here reflect post-review adjustments and may not align with Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation data as published in its 2023 and 2024 surveys [(Starts and Completions survey)](https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en#TableMapChart/35/2/Ontario). Over a two-year period, however, statistics across both organizations will align.

Learn more about [Ontario’s progress to build more homes faster.](https://www.ontario.ca/page/building-more-homes)

resources.description:
This dictionary provides information on how many new homes have been started towards municipal housing targets, as shown in the [2024 Progress](https://data.ontario.ca/en/dataset/ontario-s-housing-supply-progress/resource/3bb04ba5-2445-44e0-9d2c-8a25dd1b18e6). 

The following definitions are included:

* municipality
* 10-year housing target (2022-2031)
* total housing progress since 2022
* target for 2024
* total 2024 housing progress
     * housing starts 
     * additional residential units 
     * long-term care beds
     * licensed congregate retirement home suites 
     * postsecondary student beds
* progress % for 2024
* housing target status

Please note that due to changes in datasets counted toward progress from year to year, this data dictionary may differ from other years. 

Learn more about [Ontario’s progress to build more homes faster.](https://www.ontario.ca/page/building-more-homes)
